extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Volusia County has a $35 monthly premium, a $350 drug deductible and a $4000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent delivered the TPMO disclaimer before discussing benefits, collected the Scope of Appointment, and scheduled an appointment 3 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika, you mentioned that the Mutual of Omaha plan has a 'maximum out-of-pocket' of $4000. While this is a correct statement, it may be more accurate to say that it's a 'maximum out-of-pocket limit' to avoid any potential confusion.
